name: The Colony

frame.name: Insectoid Robot Grenades
frame.description: This weapon's grenades are insectoid robots that chase targets and explode close to them. Consumes tougher combatants to create additional robots.

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.description:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Serve the Colony
perks.description: Insectoid robot grenades quickly repopulate the magazine from reserves while the Colony is unequipped.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: We outnumber you. We will find you. You are alone, and we are colony.
